name: Rosin X
description: Rosin X (CAS 85026-55-7 ) is a modified rosin derivative used as a plasticizer, softener, and surface modification agent across rubber processing and specialty coating applications. It bridges the functional gap between conventional rosin and fully synthetic alternatives, offering resin-compatible performance in demanding industrial formulations for various sectors. In rubber and tire manufacturing, it functions as a processing aid and softener, improving compound workability and tack during mixing and calendering processes. Textile and leather finishing operations use it to modify surface wetting behavior, enabling more uniform coating adhesion and penetration into fibrous substrates. In paper and packaging, it supports sizing and surface treatment processes where controlled hydrophobicity and resin compatibility are required for high-quality results. Printing ink formulators incorporate it as a resin modifier to adjust viscosity, adhesion, and film-forming characteristics in solvent-based and oil-based ink systems. Rosin X is typically supplied as a solid or semi-solid resin, available in flake or block form depending on the producer and specific industrial requirements. Technical-grade material is the standard commercial offering. Buyers should confirm softening point, acid value, and purity specifications directly with the supplier before use.
